verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ states that users can opt out of having their conversation activity used for model training at any time, and says training is one of the uses of that data. This directly delivers the control the story asks for. A community comment notes the scope covers the standalone Copilot app and website rather than Copilot inside Office 365, and another user was unsure whether Word content was used for training. That unease is a clarity concern, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: documentation of where and how the opt-out toggle works, clear coverage of Copilot embedded in Office/365 apps, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out takes effect.
